Overview

Atoma is a shared, judged mind for engineering work — one hyperbolic map, built from many models, that retrieves atoms, verifies them, and acts on them. It keeps the team in control while the repetitive work gets done once, properly.

Dispatch is an AI-powered operations layer for support teams that turns customer requests into completed work.

It connects your helpdesk, knowledge base, and CRM to resolve tickets, run approved workflows, and keep records accurate so your team ships faster outcomes with full visibility and control.

SOURCE CONNECT

Connect sources with provenance attached.

ACTION RUNNER

Execute updates, tasks, and notifications.

APPROVAL GATE

Require approval for sensitive actions.

AUDIT + INSIGHTS

Track changes and spot patterns.

Atoma 1–7

One mind, seven layers deep.

  1. 01

    Lorentz Hyperbolic Multi-Model Mind

    Show the MAP on top. One hyperbolic map, built from many models, not separate specialists.

    Everything below reads from or writes to this map — 1 map, 12 basins, 5 models distilled into it.
  2. 02

    Nested KV

    The Poincaré ball nested INSIDE the map, not beside it. Memory lives in the map’s own geometry.

    Model attention state lives here, bound to map atoms.
  3. 03

    Meta-Cog Automaton

    Overwatch, not loop manager. Validator + confidence re-ranker + prediction operator, watching loop quality across turns.

    Propose → verify → commit or rollback. It governs every proposal from the layers below before execution.
  4. 04

    Rust / Tokio Inference

    The custom Rust inference server, hooked to the backend. No oMLX, no SGLang.

    Runs the forward passes the automaton admits.
  5. 05

    Research Harness

    RG-AH, the sole harness. Every run leaves a status, a log, and a why-receipt.

    Runs, judges, and receipts everything the stack claims.
  6. 06

    Glimmer

    The model seat for the meta-cognitive work. Muse-Glimmer family, with its tokenizer brought back in.

    Proposes under the automaton’s overwatch, through the Rust server.
  7. 07

    UI

    The Atoma app surface. The only surface Stewart invokes — the desktop app, not a web UI workaround.

    The only place a person touches the stack — status, runs, receipts, memory.

STACK: LORENTZ → NESTED KV → META-COG → RUST/TOKIO → RESEARCH HARNESS → GLIMMER → UI

Map holds KV; automaton watches inference; harness judges Glimmer’s work; UI is where a person sees and drives all of it.
